# rixl_audio_tracks (Data Source)

Lists all audio tracks associated with a specific video asset.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rixl_audio_tracks" "all_tracks" {
  video_id = var.rixl_video_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `video_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `audio_tracks` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audio_tracks))
